d: North Korea has expelled Switzerland’s top diplomat in Pyongyang, ordering him to leave within 48 hours and shutting down a diplomatic office that had reopened just weeks earlier. The trigger was Switzerland’s decision to sanction the Songdowon summer camp over allegations that Ukrainian children from Russian-occupied territories were taken there and exposed to pro-Russian propaganda and ideological indoctrination.
